scope: oracle_K, graph-only A, CPU PyTorch, full graph; not a new clustering principle
one_sentence_observation: Sampled BerPo loss materializes endpoint embedding copies and scatters their gradients; an existing sparse sampled-matrix primitive may compute the same ordered pair dots with fewer intermediate tensors.
single_change: Only BerpoDecoder.loss_batch pair-dot primitive; full-training loss selection, GCN, sampler, initialization, epochs/patience, regularizer, optimizer, threshold and K remain identical.
controls: original elementwise pairdot with same refactored wrapper; compare original frozen adapter for harness equivalence
existing torch.bmm pairdot with identical gathered pairs
original elementwise with max_epochs 1000 instead of 500, unchanged patience; runtime paid
original native BigCLAM same oracle-K panel; existing methods ignoring K may be shown with disclosure
existing known-fix and stronger Ego configurations/native Highway retained in their information panel
prediction_before_candidate_quality: Larger embedding width is the most promising speed regime; small graphs may lose to unique/CSR preparation. No guaranteed gain. Floating reduction/backward ordering may change optimization and covers, so mathematical loss identity does not imply bitwise trained output.
non_claims: not an original sampled matrix primitive
not GPU or cross-language algorithmic superiority
not label-selected checkpoints or case rules
mathematical_status: Established bilinear dot and first-order derivative identity; duplicates restored in original order and both F and F.T receive gradients. Finite-precision effects must be measured.

pre_confirmation_gate.quality_metric: matched macro F1, with membership micro/at-least-two recall reported together
pre_confirmation_gate.scope_limitation: Any stratum tradeoff must remain in the tables. A stratum-only claim cannot be called whole-grid domination. Gates are feasibility/reporting criteria, not hypothesis-test p-values.
pre_confirmation_gate.selection: one global backend configuration, never choose by case/true overlap/score at inference

confirmation_policy: Only if stable development speed/quality signal, freeze selected single primitive implementation (including existing bmm control if it is strongest) and strongest old controls, use graph211/212 and algorithm173/174/175; no retuning after confirmation; preregister alternative generator and degree-only diagnostics before candidate scores there.
